patch: Our reinforcements from beyond the sky, warriors of high esteem.
Not at all. It's good to see you bouncing back with such energy after that tough battle.
If you're not keen on just sitting around, Miss Trailblazer, why not go with them? The Grove is a picturesque place, perfect for sightseeing.
Let's hope that it's just a false alarm. We should place our trust in her and Castorice, teacher...
I apologize for tasking you to spearhead the plan once again, but Okhema is currently beset by enemies from within and without.
Esteemed one, the Oronyx's vacant totem awaits.
Go. I will not stand in your way. As for you... you are someone who has cheated death. I believe you have more than enough reason to make the trip with Castorice and meet the god of "Death" themself.
Trinnon, please recite the prophecy for us. Trailblazer, please surrender that scalding Coreflame for us as well.

I deeply regret and feel guilty for hastily pushing you and the Trailblazer into the debate. But please forgive me — at that moment, I could not afford to show any sign of weakness before you, as it would have crushed your morale.
Take a seat. Make yourself comfortable, then close your eyes.
You can open your eyes now.
Thank you. The agreement between us is now complete.
The party that will embark on the expedition to Castrum Kremnos is decided: Phainon from Aedes Elysiae, Mydei from Castrum Kremnos, and... the distinguished guest from the outlands.
Now that you are here, why don't we let someone who's truly worldly enlighten us?
What form of government have most civilizations across this vast cosmos survived with to this day?
I can imagine our conversations here will only get more... unrestrained. Don't let our rare moments of joy hold you back.
See, this is what happens when you put the Empress of Law and the Crown Prince of Strife in the same room.
